description.zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 每页可展示的记录数，取值： **30~100**，默认值为**30**。
description.en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: **30 to 100**. Default value: **30**.
The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

descriptions.en:
### [](#)Supported database engine

SQL Server

>  You can call the [DescribeHistoryTasks](~~2627863~~) operation to query the tasks on an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
